name: Label
description: Static or bound text label. Used standalone for headings and, most commonly, inside the field label wrapper (see atoms/field-label-wrapper.json).

text.description: Literal text, or a binding expression (see expressions/binding-expression-dsl.md) for dynamic labels, e.g. counts/summaries.

className.description: Almost always "entryLabel" when used inside a field wrapper. Free-form for standalone headings/captions.
